div.h1: Pattern C · A2A inbound (room exposed as an A2A agent)
div.h3: Card discovery + JSON-RPC -> injected onto the room's SLIM channel

text.tspan: Inbound A2A is fire-and-ack (card advertises streaming=false). The external client
gets an acknowledgement, not the room's eventual reply. The hub is again the translation
boundary: it terminates the HTTPS JSON-RPC in plaintext, then republishes onto MLS.

g.text: 7. delivered as a normal room message
